name: R025-shield-dust-kings-rock
why: The player's Hitmonchan (set 339, King's Rock, Mach Punch in slot 1) uses Mach Punch every turn on the opponent's lead Venomoth (set 331, Shield Dust; no Skill Swap in this set). Mach Punch is King's Rock affected, and Fighting is quarter damage against Bug/Poison (about 10-12 of Venomoth's 166 HP), so Venomoth never faints and every hit has a 10% King's Rock roll; a winning roll calls the flinch SetMoveEffect directly and Shield Dust returns first. Mach Punch has priority, so Hitmonchan hits once per turn until Venomoth's Psychic/Sludge Bomb/Signal Beam/Giga Drain (random among the four at challenge 2) knock it out, about 4-5 hits.
